{
    "name": "insomnia-importers-browser",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "description": "Use insomnia-importers package directly in the browser",
    "main": "dist/insomnia-importers-browser.js",
    "type": "module",
    "license": "MIT",
    "devDependencies": {
        "assert": "^2.0.0",
        "browserify-zlib": "^0.2.0",
        "buffer": "^6.0.3",
        "crypto-browserify": "^3.12.0",
        "https-browserify": "^1.0.0",
        "insomnia-importers": "^3.6.0",
        "path-browserify": "^1.0.1",
        "stream-browserify": "^3.0.0",
        "stream-http": "^3.2.0",
        "timers-browserify": "^2.0.12",
        "url": "^0.11.0",
        "util": "^0.12.5",
        "webpack": "^5.75.0",
        "webpack-cli": "^5.0.0"
    },
    "scripts": {
        "build": "webpack"
    }
}

## Install

```sh
npm install https://github.com/flawiddsouza/insomnia-importers-browser
```

## Usage

```js
import { convert } from 'insomnia-importers-browser'

const exportFile = '<export file>'
const result = await convert(exportFile)
console.log(result)
```
